title: Authorize supplier master data with live menu authority and bounded field validation
description: Stage 3 procurement master-data closure for the supplier records that every purchase quote, purchase order, stock-in and supplier payment resolves against. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:124-153 declares SupplierController over BaseCrudController<BaseSupplier> with only [ApiController]/[Route("api/base/suppliers")]/[Authorize]; GetPaged at 137-143 and GetById at 146-152 only attach sourcing annotations, and Create/Update/Delete/BatchDelete inherit the unguarded generic routes in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92, which call IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs:31-117, zero Authoriz/Menu references), so any authenticated account can list, create, rewrite and delete any supplier. Reuse the existing supplier functional menu (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:26) on every route and add bounded server-side validation for the persisted BaseSupplier columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseSupplier.cs:12-96) before persisting, keeping the existing supplier-code unique index semantics (src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:30) and the existing paging/response contracts unchanged. No grants, no anonymous/admin fallback, no schema change. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/base/suppliers (paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch-delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing supplier functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that SupplierCode and SupplierName are non-empty and within their persisted length bounds, that the optional persisted supplier text and numeric fields stay within their persisted bounds, and that Status is a known enabled/disabled value, returning the existing controlled validation errors without silently clamping or rewriting any supplier row and keeping the existing supplier-code uniqueness semantics unchanged, so a rejected write persists no BaseSuppliers row.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing supplier menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid code, name, bounds and status payloads, and assert that denied list, create, update, delete and batch-delete calls read or mutate no BaseSuppliers row while the existing GenericService contracts stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseDataControllers.cs:124-153 declares SupplierController with only [Authorize] over BaseCrudController<BaseSupplier>; GetPaged at 137-143 and GetById at 146-152 only add sourcing annotations and the base generic routes in src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:38-92 (GetPaged 38-43, GetAll 46-51, GetById 54-59, Create 62-67, Update 70-76, Delete 79-84, batch-delete 87-92) call IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs, which contains zero Authoriz/Menu/scope references). BaseSupplier (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/BaseSupplier.cs:12-96) persists SupplierCode/SupplierName/EnglishName/ContactPerson/Phone/Email/Country/Address/PaymentTerms/BankName/BankAccount/Status plus SupplierType/BoothLocation/MainCategory/SettlementMethod/InvoiceAbility/TaxRate/DeliveryDays/RebateRatio/WeChat/Remark with only attribute annotations and no server-side rule; the unique index is src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/ErpDbContext.Config.cs:30. The existing supplier menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:26. An exact search of .ai/tasks shows ERP-441 only closed the product sourcing relations (ProductSupplierController/SupplierSourcingController) and no task lists SupplierController for live authorization.
